# GENERATED by tools/gen_st_recommender.py. Edit the generator, not this file.

# The draft's price rule and best-quantity search, ported from
# tools/gen_smart_trade_gui.py (Market.rh/rp/spread/gain/marginal), evaluated
# in the player's scope against variables the effect loads per (good,
# partner):
#   st_rec_bh st_rec_sh  home buy / sell orders      st_rec_k     0.75 x base price
#   st_rec_bp st_rec_sp  partner buy / sell orders   st_rec_ship  shipping per unit
#   st_rec_t             the trial quantity          st_rec_q     the current best
# Clamps: `max = X` caps at X (so value, max = X is min(value, X)) and
# `min = X` floors at X (max(value, X)), applied in the order written.

# --- inputs, read once per pair through saved scopes ------------------------
# scope:x = { add = ... } in a value: vanilla 00_infamy_values.txt,
# command_values.txt. market_goods_* as values: vanilla script values.
st_rec_in_bh = { value = 0 scope:st_rec_h = { add = market_goods_buy_orders } }
st_rec_in_sh = { value = 0 scope:st_rec_h = { add = market_goods_sell_orders } }
st_rec_in_bp = { value = 0 scope:st_rec_p = { add = market_goods_buy_orders } }
st_rec_in_sp = { value = 0 scope:st_rec_p = { add = market_goods_sell_orders } }
st_rec_in_k = { value = 0 scope:st_rec_h = { add = goods.base_price } multiply = 0.75 }
st_rec_in_surplus = { value = 0 scope:st_rec_h = { add = market_goods_sell_orders subtract = market_goods_buy_orders } }
# Shipping per unit: zero when the markets touch, else the merchant marine
# the draft assumes (traded_quantity units per merchant marine) x 1.25,
# priced in the player's market. Same as the draft (Market.ship_unit).
st_rec_in_ship = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { var:st_rec_adj < 1 }
		value = var:st_rec_mm
		divide = var:st_rec_tq
		multiply = 1.25
	}
}
st_rec_in_mm = { value = 0 market = { mg:merchant_marine ?= { add = st_price } } }
# The quantity ceiling: what the AI fully accepts (its shortage + 10, floor
# 10; Market.q_accept_send), and vanilla's own maximum (quantity_max_value:
# the partner's import cap minus its treaty imports, our export cap minus
# ours). Floor 10, vanilla's minimum.
st_rec_in_vmax_p = { value = 0 scope:st_rec_p = { add = market_import_cap subtract = treaty_imports } }
st_rec_in_vmax_h = { value = 0 scope:st_rec_h = { add = market_export_cap subtract = treaty_exports } }
st_rec_in_cap = {
	value = var:st_rec_bp
	subtract = var:st_rec_sp
	add = 10
	min = 10
	max = st_rec_in_vmax_p
	max = st_rec_in_vmax_h
	min = 10
}
# A row must earn at least 1 a week: the top 5 profitable deals show, however
# small (Damien, 2026-11-13; the 1%-of-income bar is gone).
st_rec_in_min = { value = 1 }

st_rec_b_safe = { value = st_rec_b min = 0.01 }
st_rec_s_safe = { value = st_rec_s min = 0.01 }
st_rec_sh_safe = { value = var:st_rec_sh min = 0.01 }
st_rec_bp_safe = { value = var:st_rec_bp min = 0.01 }
st_rec_rh_den = { value = st_rec_b max = var:st_rec_sh min = 0.01 }
st_rec_rp_den = { value = var:st_rec_bp max = st_rec_s min = 0.01 }
st_rec_rh = { value = st_rec_b subtract = var:st_rec_sh divide = st_rec_rh_den }

# Price slopes, zero while that price sits at its cap (Market.marginal).

	value = st_rec_rh
	save_temporary_value_as = st_rec_rh_v
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:st_rec_rh_v > -1 scope:st_rec_rh_v < 1 }
		value = st_rec_slope_h_a
		min = st_rec_slope_h_b
	}
}

	value = st_rec_rp

# The partner's base acceptance of a treaty with the player: vanilla's own
# static_treaty_acceptance (common/script_values), which wants root = the
# evaluating country and scope:other_country = the proposer. ROOT HERE MUST
# BE THE PARTNER: the GUI evaluates it through Country.MakeScope.ScriptValue,
# and each AI country stores it on its own monthly pulse; the player's scan
# cannot, because its root is the player. Single player: the proposer is the
# human country, kept in global_var:st_rec_player (set at game start, by
# every scan, and by the AI pulse when missing).
# Confirmed 2026-11-13: the value matches the treaty draft's (Great Britain
# toward Spain, 1836: -31 to -33). A first version found the player with
# every_country; the value was right but GetScriptValueDesc (the hover)
# lost the saved scope, ~100 "value of type none" errors per line. The scope
# is now saved through a link block, as vanilla's own first lines do.
st_rec_acc = {
	value = 0
	global_var:st_rec_player ?= {
		save_temporary_scope_as = other_country
	}
	add = static_treaty_acceptance
}

		}
		add = {
			desc = "DIPLOMATIC_ACCEPTANCE_EQUAL_EXCHANGE"
			value = 30
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:is_renegotiation }
			scope:treaty_options ?= {
				is_historical_treaty = yes
				remaining_binding_period > 0
			}
		}
		add = {
			desc = "TRIGGER_IS_HISTORICAL_TREATY_NONE"
			value = 1000
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:is_renegotiation
			exists = scope:bad_faith_factor
			scope:treaty_options.amended_treaty ?= {
				is_historical_treaty = yes
				remaining_binding_period > 0
			}
		}
		add = {
			desc = "TRIGGER_IS_HISTORICAL_TREATY_NONE"
			value = -1000
		}
	}
}
